incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High risk: potential VPC route contamination detected impacting dedicated-pool rp-gamma-07. Affected customers: cust-559, cust-662. Pager sent to oncall.

Darla (oncall): seeing it. grabbing logs now, is this the route-shadow pattern we saw last month?

Miguel: confirming intermittent cross-tenant path shows up in BGP snapshots and in our internal route cache. putting initial filtered query: `query routes where pool==rp-gamma-07 and prefix.len < 24` -> matches 2 unexpected prefixes from cust-559 that also appear in cust-662.

Priya: tagging runtime traces — io path shows KV cache lookups for requests originating from cust-662 hitting objects owned by cust-559 for ~2-3m window. this looks like a routing table misbind at the allocator level, not app-layer.

Darla (oncall): good catch. impact = possible cross-tenant data exposure for inference requests. priority = P0. Lina, can you notify account team and prep the customer message template? we may need an interim mitigation before full RCA.

Lina (customer-success): on it. I'll draft a scoped notification: "we detected anomalous routing that may have impacted requests between your VPC and another tenant. We're actively mitigating and will provide timeline." Will wait for exact mitigation details.

Sam (eng-platform): quick question — did autoscale trigger any recent pool migrations? checking control-plane audit: `PATCH /pools/rp-gamma-07/assignments` at 2026-11-03T01:12:14Z by autoscaler-runner. rolling back last assignment may stop the leak if that's the mutation.

Miguel: logs correlate — autoscaler batch job pinned an ephemeral route binding that clobbered tenant namespace mapping when a host restarted. looks like a race: allocator didn't re-assert tenant label before route broadcast.

ops-bot: mitigation suggestion: `drain-host --host host-17 --mode immediate && unassign-route --prefix 10.34.7.0/24 --pool rp-gamma-07` (requires oncall approval). Also recommend toggling strict-routing for pool to fail-closed.

Darla (oncall): approve drain-host host-17 now. executing:```bash
draining host-17 (immediate)
# monitor: tail -f /var/log/allocator/host-17.log | grep "route-announce"
```

Jordan (night-shift): taking handoff at +20m. if drain fails, we should flip pool-level denylist for cross-tenant prefixes: `route-policy set rp-gamma-07 enforce-strict true` and then restart announcer. I'll be on-call for the next 4h.

Priya: adding temporary KV cache eviction rule for the two suspect prefixes to prevent stale cross-tenant cache hits: `kvcache.evict(prefix=10.34.7.0/24)` — pushing policy now.

Miguel: host drain completed, route unassigned. control-plane shows the orphaned prefix withdrawn. verifying traces — no new cross-tenant hits after 90s. partial mitigation success.

ops-bot: running post-mitigation checks: `route-sanity-check --pool rp-gamma-07 --threshold 0` -> OK. `kvcache-check --prefix 10.34.7.0/24` -> entries cleared.

Lina (customer-success): sent preliminary notice to cust-662 and cust-559: "we observed and mitigated a routing anomaly. no confirmed exfiltration; we will share a timeline and next steps within 8 hours." they acknowledged receipt.

Darla (oncall): great. capturing incident token and starting timeline. Sam, can you schedule a rollback/vetted fix for the allocator race? we need an invariant test and a canary rollout.

Sam (eng-platform): already on it. plan: patch allocator to assert tenant label pre-announce, add unit + integration test that simulates host restarts, then canary deploy to rp-gamma-08 for 48h. ETA for patch PR: 3 hours.

Jordan (night-shift): I'll keep monitoring heartbeat and route announcements. if anything reappears, I'll escalate to SRE lead. taking responsibility for the running incident during night.

Miguel: logging audit artifacts: snapshot of BGP table, route announcements from host-17, and control-plane mutations. pushing to /incidents/2102467890/artifacts.

Darla (oncall): thanks. retrospective items: 1) allocator race fix 2) add route sanity gating before autoscaler assignment 3) improve customer notification playbook for routing leaks. adding to ticket.

incident-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-1147. Severity=P0. Handed off to Jordan (night-shift). Next update at 2102469099 or earlier if status changes."
